_comment: Hand-maintained seed for the Steam page. scripts/fetch-steam.mjs reads this,
enriches every appid from Steam's PUBLIC store API (names, prices, discounts,
review scores, release dates) and writes site/data/steam.json.
WHY THE PLAYTIME LIVES HERE AND IS NOT FETCHED
The Steam profile is set to private (privacyState=private on the public
profile XML), so IPlayerService/GetOwnedGames and the community games XML
both refuse. There is no public endpoint that will return this account's
library or wishlist. The store API, by contrast, is public for everyone --
so prices and review scores DO refresh on every deploy; only the list of
appids and the hours are pinned here.
To refresh the hours: open steamcommunity.com/id/parkerhunt/games?tab=all
while logged in and update `minutes` below. Set the profile to public and
this whole file can be replaced by a live fetch.
minutes = playtime_forever. ach = [unlocked, total]; omit if the game has
no achievements. Games with minutes = 0 are the free Valve bundle and render
as a single line rather than a row each.
`extra` is neither owned nor wishlisted: it is every game in the played-it
list (site/data/games.toml) that happens to exist on Steam but was played
somewhere else -- on a console, on Game Pass, or on an account that predates
this one. They are here only so that list gets real names, real links and
local art instead of hand-typed strings. Games that are not on Steam at all
(Fortnite, Minecraft, Skate 3) carry their titles in games.toml instead.
